parsed.explanation: No gender-expression offence and no documented visitor-facing universal exposure (no bathroom rule, birth-sex custody practice, or border document friction documented). But the state is actively hostile: gender-affirming surgery criminalised under Art. 8 with real penalties, no legal gender recognition, cybercrime and public-morality/debauchery provisions used to harass LGBT people with impunity, and a coordinated crackdown that coerced queer spaces shut and drove trans people abroad. A 2019 regional survey found 93% non-acceptance — hostile society, thin community infrastructure, no anti-discrimination recourse. Much of the documented repression targets activists (local sphere, discounted under rule 20), and the surgery ban is resident-facing; no documented stops, refusals or violence against trans visitors. Worst documented feature is tier-3 hostility with no working remedy, short of the tier-1/2 exposures in the 0.45 anchors. Above 0.25-tier organised targeting, below documented visitor-facing institutional exclusion.
